prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original bitmap environment map for a top-down 2D dark fantasy RPG, one continuous square map. Primary request: Titan Tomb, an ancient gigantic burial sanctuary with broad connected traversable stone floors. Camera: near top-down orthographic 45-degree oblique/isometric, no horizon, same scale everywhere. Style: richly detailed hand-painted realistic classic dark fantasy game environment, desaturated grey-brown stone, subtle moss, warm small braziers, soft light from upper left, dark teal shadows. Layout: the west edge has a clearly visible wide stone road entering at the exact vertical midpoint and continuing unbroken into a broad central stone courtyard. Keep the ENTIRE west-east central lane walkable, and north-south central lane walkable, with a large empty central arena. Rooms surround it as connected rectangular open plazas, with clearly visible wide stairways and passages. Giant carved funerary guardian statues and huge sealed stone sarcophagi sit only on the outer edges, pillars around perimeter, broken massive skeletal ribs and skull fossils against boundary walls, no living beings. A grand sealed tomb facade along the north edge, a bone dragon burial chamber toward the southeast corner, empty large arena for the actual game monsters. Outer border blends into barren grey-brown rocky ground with sparse dead scrub, suitable to join desert/mining regions. Avoid black void surrounding floors; perimeter can have low rubble but there must be continuous solid ground connecting the central courtyard and all four quadrants. Keep main walkable stone floor area at least 65 percent, readable flat surfaces, architectural props should not cover the central cross-shaped travel routes. No characters, no monsters, no UI, no text, no logos, no watermark, no grid lines. Original artwork, no commercial game assets.
